name: The Desert Fathers
translation: Selected excerpts adapted from the Apophthegmata Patrum and early public-domain translations
note: The sayings of the monks who fled to the Egyptian desert in the fourth century — Anthony, Macarius, Moses the Black and their sisters and brothers. Christianity's first school of inner life, recorded as short answers to those who came asking: Abba, give me a word.

books.name: Sayings of the Desert Fathers — Selections
